wax.name: Wax Powder
wax.short: Volume and texture, without the weight.
wax.desc: The powder Thomas uses to add volume at the root and texture all over, with a natural matte finish. It goes on dry, restyles whenever you like and washes out with normal shampoo.
use: Unscrew the cap.
Shake a little powder onto dry roots.
Work it in with your fingers for volume.

clay.name: Matte Clay
clay.desc: The clay Thomas uses for texture and volume without shine. Work it into dry hair or hair that has just been blow-dried, and it holds all day.
use: Warm a small amount between your palms.
Work it in from the nape towards the front.
Restyle whenever you like: it never hardens.

pomata.name: Pomata Shine
pomata.short: Razor parting and a clean shine.
pomata.desc: Water-based pomade for side parts, a sharp parting and a glossy finish. It washes out with normal shampoo and leaves no residue.
use: Apply to damp hair with your fingers.
Comb from the parting outwards.
Set it with the hairdryer for a drier shine.

olio.name: Olio Barba
olio.desc: A few drops soften the beard, tame stray hairs and give a natural finish. Notes of wood and amber.
use: Pour 3-4 drops into your palm.
Warm it up and spread from root to tip.
Comb to define the shape.

sale.name: Sea Salt Spray
sale.desc: The pre-styler that gives fine hair body and short cuts texture. It dries in seconds without stiffening.
use: Spray onto damp hair.
Blow-dry, tousling as you go.
Finish with Matte Clay if you want more hold.

kit.name: Fade Kit
kit.short: The whole fade routine at home, for less.
kit.desc: Matte Clay, Sea Salt Spray and Olio Barba in one order. The set Thomas recommends to anyone leaving the chair with a fresh fade.
use: Sea Salt on damp hair.
Matte Clay for texture and hold.
Olio Barba to finish.

gift.name: Gift Card
gift.short: For a haircut, a beard trim or a product.
gift.desc: It arrives by email right after the order, ready to forward. Valid for every service and product at the studio, for 12 months.
use: Choose the amount.
You get it by email within minutes.
The recipient books in the app and shows it at the till.

club.name: Fade Membership
club.short: A fresh fade, at a fixed price.
club.desc: Two haircuts a month for €36 instead of €50. It starts with your first booking and you can cancel whenever you like.
use: Start the membership.
Book your two haircuts in the app.
Cancel at the studio, no penalties.
